exposure: Magnetic resonance (MR) imaging estimated fetal weight (EFW)
cohort: The study included 270 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent both US-EFW and MR-EFW within 48 hours before delivery.
finding: MR-EFW performed immediately prior to delivery predicts SGA neonates (defined by birthweight <=10th and <=5th centile) significantly better than US-EFW, but there was no significant difference for predicting SGA by birthweight <=3rd centile.
birth_weight: Neonates with birthweight <=10th, <=5th, and <=3rd centile were the outcome measures.
gest_age: SGA is defined in relation to gestational age, but no specific gestational age range for the cohort was provided.
